shape.knownRevision: optional canonical unsigned BIGINT decimal string; cache reads only, outside business data

loanMetadata.baseline: confirmed principal at the start of baselineDate; never the entire account balance
loanMetadata.owner: trusted server identity, uid-scoped loan/account FK
loanMetadata.schedule: optional structured plan params; scheduleMethod/scheduleTerms/measurementKind all-or-none; kind=rate needs quoteType+ratePpm, kind=repayment needs repaymentMinor and forbids quote fields; installment quote requires flat method; rate is integer ppm (12.5% = 125000), amounts integer minor units, daily quote uses 360-day year; feeUpfrontMinor < installmentSetup.originalPrincipalMinor for new installments, otherwise < baselinePrincipalMinor when both set; changing params never recalculates an existing plan

installmentSetup.originalPrincipalMinor: positive integer minor string, distinct from current baseline
installmentSetup.historicalPaidTerms: confirmed consecutive paid terms before enrollment, integer 0..scheduleTerms; never inferred from dates
installmentSetup.customRecordType: trimmed string <=12 code points, only for other
installmentSetup.discountValue: null with null kind; positive minor string for cash discounts or ppm ratio <=1000000 for interest discount (7折=700000)

loanMetadata.installmentRules: New page always kind=installment, requires firstPaymentDate, previews remaining schedule and confirms baseline/date. Historical rows never create payments; remaining principal equals sum of later planned principal. Interest discount recomputes using reduced rate; cash discounts reduce fees then interest, never principal. Total discount is allocated across the full original schedule with bounded integer rounding before slicing history. Upfront fees are metadata only, excluded from remaining-plan totals. Legacy nullable setup remains readable.

readResponse.unchanged: knownRevision equals snapshot revision; no business payload; requires matching full local snapshot

rules: trusted identity and active status, same read-only snapshot
no aggregate queries; coalesced once per foreground

repayment: confirmed=true, mode=defer|associate, assetAccountId, liabilityAccountId (other_liability), explicit principalMinor/interestMinor/feeMinor, expense|accrued treatment and expense category IDs; exact total. associate additionally requires loanId/loanVersion. Financial transactions, confirmed details and optional loan share commit atomically.
Only active confirmed repayments with no allocations. Confirm stored composition and matching account/baseline; update loan/payment versions without adding transactions.
Release only pending confirmed repayments, preserving all financial transactions. Never silently detach an allocated payment.

returns: allocations (whole-payment shares; first 3 actual periods, periodCount, unallocated components)
evidence (bounded raw hints, never confirmed financial facts)
rules: Trusted uid; consistent read-only snapshot; active linked/replaced relations take priority for every account type. Only explicitly confirmed active repayments without loan allocations return candidate with payment and repayment details. Ordinary transfers to every account type return none. No inferred installment, amount or period; revoked relations are not reported active.

data: accountId? (liability; credit accepted with empty results)
rules: Only confirmed active repayments without loan allocations; whole financial group appears once; returns total and repaymentTotalMinor; cursor binds uid/month/account. Credit bill repayments remain ordinary transfers without a loan-association prompt.

1..100 unique current-user manual/import transactions; all-or-nothing; versions, loan associations, final cash balance and refunds outside selection validated; archived accounts allowed; selected original and refunds can be removed together; frozen receipt recoverable via transactions.commandResult.
One private job per authenticated user; one hour expiry; start/replay does not change business revision.
Signed keyset/UTF-8 fragment cursor; 50 completed rows and 65536 UTF-8 text bytes maximum; unchanged business revision required.
Only signed terminal token; active user lock checks revision; immutable completed result can be replayed.

loans.periods.returns: {loanId,loanName,loanVersion,summary,items,nextCursor}; page 1..40; optional at most 40 selected IDs, same loan only; signed cursor includes loan version. Summary includes unpaid principal/interest/fee, next due date, remaining principal and explicit gap; never mark paid by date; paidPeriods counts fully paid active plan rows from actual allocations; installment setup adds historicalPaidTerms and totalTerms, displayed separately from actual paid periods.

loans.savePeriod.returns: {loanId,loanVersion,periodId,version}; period number 1..9999 unique per loan, explicit nonnegative components with positive total. Revision preserves original plan; cannot reduce below paid components or cancel paid period; no Transaction writes; installment periodNumber must be greater than historicalPaidTerms.

loans.allocatePeriods.returns: {paymentId,version,loanId,loanVersion,allocatedPeriods}; replace this active repayment's allocations for one loan, 0..40 unique versioned periods with explicit principal/interest/fee. Preserve old rows; each component bounded by payment share and period remainder; unallocated remainder remains explicit

loans.planAllocation.returns: {loanVersion,payment,share,items,unallocated}; max 40 active period allocations for current loan; actual allocated+unallocated components equal repayment share

loans.periodHistory.returns: {periodId,kind,items,nextCursor}; kind=plan|payment; page 1..40, user/period/kind signed cursor; preserve plan revisions and replaced/reversed actual allocation facts

data: loanId? (read stored params and original principal when setup exists, else principal baseline)
loans.previewPlan.returns: {periods:[{periodNumber,dueDate,principalMinor,interestMinor,feeMinor}],summary:{totalPaymentMinor,totalInterestMinor,totalFeeMinor,derivedRatePpm?,remainingPrincipalMinor?,historicalPaidTerms?,totalTerms?,upfrontFeeMinor?}}; new setup slices original N historical terms, preserves original period numbers, omits zero-payment tasks; optional remaining/history fields only with setup.
rules: Read-only trusted user snapshot; supplied setup original principal is authoritative over principalMinor. Legacy date fallback and upfront-inclusive totals remain; new setup requires explicit first date when saved and remaining totals exclude upfront fee. Zero payment months are not persisted. No auto-paid-by-date behavior.

Stored params and original principal (new setup) or positive baseline (legacy) required; existing periods including cancelled reject LOAN_PLAN_EXISTS. Zero remaining periods rejects validation. Under one user lock/transaction insert only unpaid historical suffix, preserving original numbers and version-1 revisions, and advance loan version. No Transaction/payment/balance writes; later maintenance through savePeriod/allocatePeriods. Replay frozen receipt.

data: accountId? (filter before paging; bound to cursor)
loans.list.returns: {items: Loan[], pendingRepaymentCount: number, nextCursor: string|null}; pageSize 1..40; signed user-scoped cursor

loans.create.returns: {loanId,version,generatedPeriods?}; new installmentSetup requires kind=installment and confirmed atomic metadata + remaining periods/revisions + receipt; supplied baseline must equal computed remaining principal. Legacy metadata-only requests stay supported. Neither path creates Transaction or changes balances.

loans.update.returns: {loanId,version}; omitted installmentSetup preserves stored setup. Existing new-style periods lock original principal, history, discounts, schedule fields and baseline. Name/classification may change. Never regenerates plans; generatePlan is rejected here.

loans.record.returns: {paymentId,version,transactionCount,loans:[{loanId,version}],previousPaymentId?}; mode=new|associate|correctExisting; max 20 unique versioned loan allocations with explicit principalMinor/interestMinor/feeMinor and expense/accrued treatment; exact sum; associate only links an exact existing composition; correctExisting atomically replaces the whole source and preserves roots for reversal; replacePayment explicitly identifies a duplicate manual payment and its current loan versions

loans.source.returns: {source:{transactionIds,fingerprint,event},transactions,evidence}; select 1..60 current-user transactions; expands one imported event to all active members; signed complete transaction/event/update versions; no amount/date automatic match

loans.correct.returns: {paymentId,version,previousPaymentId,transactionCount,loans}; preserve previous reversed payment; check old/new loan versions, final cash and principal atomically; imported source total/account/time fixed

loans.reverse.returns: {paymentId,version,reversed,loans}; current versions for every allocated loan; reverse whole group or reject without partial changes

loans.payment.returns: {payment,repayment?,allocations,transactions}; pending confirmed payments have empty allocations; max 20 loans / 60 transactions, current loan versions plus frozen confirmedLoanVersion

loans.payments.returns: {items,nextCursor}; pageSize 1..40, signed user/loan scope, includes reversal history

transactions.commandResult.scope: current user frozen transaction or loan write receipt; missing or mismatched action remains OPERATION_UNCONFIRMED

catalog.get.consistency: single read-only snapshot; active categories; no balances or initialization writes

rules.identity: identity is resolved only from trusted WeChat context; identity-shaped client fields are rejected recursively; bootstrap returns the current user uid for display and saved nickname for presentation only
rules.uid: one immutable 10-digit decimal string per user, first digit nonzero; displayed and copied unchanged; existing UUID ownership is migrated by 0011; other entity and request IDs remain UUIDs
rules.money: minor-unit decimal strings only; JavaScript floating point is forbidden
rules.time: occurredLocalAt plus JavaScript getTimezoneOffset() minutes; optional date and month filters use local date
rules.mutation: requestId is UUID; same key and request replays, same key with different request conflicts
rules.deletion: accounts and categories archive; manual transactions soft-delete; no physical business deletion
rules.refund: manual refunds must reference one active original expense; imported pending refunds credit one account without affecting income or expense statistics until linked
rules.cashBalance: a write may not create or deepen a negative cash balance; historical negative cash remains visible and only improving writes or an explicit balance correction are allowed

successEnvelope.data: action-specific public result; bootstrap includes uid and saved nickname; WeChat OpenID and identity digests are never returned
